description: This source file contains extension methods for NodeAppModel, focusing on normalizing parameters related to watch notifications, including trimming strings, ensuring action lists are constrained, and mapping priorities and risks.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: An extension class providing static normalization methods related to watch notification parameters.

methods.name: normalizeWatchNotifyParams
methods.description: Normalizes and sanitizes watch notification parameters, trimming strings and setting default actions based on context.

methods.name: normalizeWatchActions
methods.description: Normalizes a list of actions, trimming their properties, limiting number, and optionally auto-inserting default actions based on context.

methods.name: normalizedWatchRisk
methods.description: Determines the normalized watch risk level based on provided risk or inferred from priority.

methods.name: normalizedWatchPriority
methods.description: Determines the normalized notification priority based on provided priority or inferred from risk level.

methods.name: trimmedOrNil
methods.description: Utility method to trim whitespace from a string or return nil if string is empty after trimming.
